title: Shed the queue: rethink unread as a library concept, not an inbox
acceptance: The sidebar no longer displays a numeric unread count
unreadCount is removed from LibraryIndex and its call sites
"Never opened" survives as a filter, not as an accusation with a number attached
notes: Found by invariants.sh on its first run: the sidebar renders index.unreadCount beside all/starred/archived. Predates the constitution's P5 ban, which is why P5 is diff-scoped. This task retires the exemption.

history.detail: criterion 4 (backlog stated plainly on request) split to T-0020: it is a separate roadmap bullet needing UI outside this task's touches. Planning error, not an implementation failure.
